Records only — secondary literature on the Sumerian Flood Story (paid / restricted / lending-only)

Retrieved/checked 2026-10-16. Nothing downloaded here (no legal free copy found). Pirate sites deliberately not used.

Work Publisher / access Approx. price Why it matters
M. Civil, "The Sumerian Flood Story", in W. G. Lambert & A. R. Millard, Atra-ḫasīs: The Babylonian Story of the Flood (Oxford: Clarendon 1969; repr. Eisenbrauns 1999), pp. 138–145, 167–172 archive.org lending only: https://archive.org/details/atrahasisbabylon0000wgla ; reprint Eisenbrauns/Penn State UP ~US$ 40–50 (pb reprint) Standard philological edition (score transliteration, translation, notes) on which ETCSL rests.
Th. Jacobsen, "The Eridu Genesis", JBL 100/4 (1981) 513–529; repr. in R. S. Hess & D. T. Tsumura (eds.), "I Studied Inscriptions from before the Flood" (Eisenbrauns 1994) 129–142 JSTOR (SBL; not free/early-journal content); stable URL via JSTOR search "Eridu Genesis Jacobsen"; catalogue: https://keibi.uni-tuebingen.de/Record/KEI00031283 JSTOR individual access / article purchase (~US$ 15–40); free 100 reads/month with a JSTOR account Composite text + translation; coined "Eridu Genesis"; reconstructs the lost parts from SKL and UET 6/1 61.
Th. Jacobsen, The Harps That Once… Sumerian Poetry in Translation (Yale UP 1987), pp. 145–150 archive.org lending only: https://archive.org/details/harpsthatoncesum0000unse ~US$ 30 (pb) Literary verse translation by Jacobsen.
Y. S. Chen, The Primeval Flood Catastrophe: Origins and Early Development in Mesopotamian Traditions (Oxford Oriental Monographs, OUP 2013; pb 2019) OUP; e-book VitalSource hb ~US$ 175; pb ~£60 Most thorough modern study of all Sumerian/Akkadian flood traditions incl. MS 3026 and the Ur ms.; argues the Flood motif is a late (OB) development.
J. Peterson, "The Divine Appointment of the First Antediluvian King: Newly Recovered Content from the Ur Version of the Sumerian Flood Story", JCS 70 (2018) 37–51 Univ. of Chicago Press / ASOR (JSTOR); abstract on Academia.edu: https://www.academia.edu/37013183 JSTOR/UCP article ~US$ 15–20 Edition of the Ur manuscript (UET 6/1 61+503+691+701) — the main new evidence since 1969 (transliteration only in ORACC P346146).
K. Volk, edition of MS 3026 (Schøyen) "forthcoming" (CUSAS / Schøyen series) — Second main manuscript, still unpublished.
B. Alster, Wisdom of Ancient Sumer (CDL Press 2005) CDL Press ~US$ 70 Standard edition of the Instructions of Šuruppag (incl. Akkadian fragments).
A. Cavigneaux & F. N. H. Al-Rawi, Gilgameš et la Mort (Cuneiform Monographs 19, Styx 2000) Brill ~€ 100+ Edition of the Me-Turan Death of Bilgameš (Ziusudra passages).
M. Civil, "Sumerian Flood" — also ETCSL bibliography: Krecher 1996 (electronic), Pettinato 1971 (Das altorientalische Menschenbild), Römer 1993 (TUAT III/3 448–458, German translation), Kramer 1983 ("The Sumerian Deluge Myth: Reviewed and Revised", Anatolian Studies 33) various — Further translations/commentaries (see ../ETCSL/1.7.4--Flood-Story/README.md).
